The second model (deepseek) correctly evaluated all files as safe. Since .SRCINFO is a non-executable metadata file, its inconclusive status should not override the safe status of the executable PKGBUILD and .install files.
learnings: The audit tool should not fail the entire package audit if a non-executable metadata file like .SRCINFO triggers a model truncation or parsing error, provided the executable files (PKGBUILD, .install) are safely audited.
